data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for age verification using Google Play Age Signals and Apple DeclaredAgeRange APIs.
data.what_it_does: It provides a cross-platform API for age verification and age range checking. It interfaces with Google Play Age Signals on Android and Apple's DeclaredAgeRange API on iOS.
use_when: You need to verify user age for compliance with regional age restriction laws.
Your app requires age gating for adult content on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are targeting older iOS versions below 26.0 or Android versions below API 23.
You want self-reported ages without relying on platform-level verification APIs.
strengths: Unified status model across both Android and iOS platforms.
Supports regional eligibility checks and regulatory feature detection on iOS.
Typed exceptions for all failure modes.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific capabilities (Declared Age Range entitlement on iOS, specific Google Play versions on Android).
Availability depends heavily on regional rollouts and store-level support.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling the Declared Age Range capability on your Apple ID and adding the entitlement to Runner.entitlements on iOS. Android requires minSdk 23+ and a Google Play Store environment.
